cases.message: That write ends at 258 of a 256 byte page.
The ECU did not take that write: 4 bytes were sent to offset 16 of page 0 and reading the same range back gave something else. Nothing has been burned, so a power cycle restores the ECU.

The ECU did not confirm the burn of page 0: The ECU did not reply.

It may still have completed — a controller stops answering while it writes its flash, which looks the same from here as one that never got the command. Turn the ignition off and on and read the tune back: if the change is there, it was burned.
